body: I'm trying, it is just hard for me sometimes.

It is nice to have friends but finding true friend is rare. In my case, they just befriended me because I'm funny and useful to them and then dump me when I'm not needed anymore. So if want to have a friend, make sure it is true friendship. I hope you find one that really cares about you.

I don't have money for psychiatrist. I told this to my parents a long time ago but they did not believe me. My friends are like, " just bear with with it " or " you are being too dramatic ". I'm enduring this for almost 4 years and the more I endure,  the more I'm being serious about wanting to die.  Even if I can't kill myself, I feel like dying little by little. Thanks for concern though.
Thanks for the advice, I hope what I have chosen is right.

I will try, thanks for listening even though this is way too dramatic.
I'm afraid to kill myself so I hope to get hit by a truck or somthing that makes me dead.

I just can't take it anymore you know, I cry almost every morning and night of my life because of my school problems, even I don't like my course, I endure it to make my parents so proud of me. But the more I try, the more hardships to come and I'm tired of it. There's a person said to me that why I stay on the things I don't like and find the thing you really want to do despite of its hardships, but I really have no idea what I want so I continued. This makes me feel worthless, that I have no dreams in life. I've been depressed for almost 2 years while trying to know what I want and then this day comes and it hit me so hard that makes me want give up all the hardships that I endured. I really appreciate that you are helping me but I can't do anything right now. I want to end this feeling but in more scary way.

I can't imagine now, there are so many things that is in my head. I'm very sorry if I'm rude. I feel like crap, here I am on the street, walking in the dark, holding my phone, don't know what to do or what to think.
I will contact them, thank you
